$comment: Thirteen invented cases for the demo, from the invented insurer Thornmere Mutual Insurance. The claimants, claims, policies and documents do not exist. Coverage check: CLM-4004 the wording is silent, CLM-4006 outside the wording, CLM-4003 the policy was not in force, CLM-4001 within the wording, CLM-4002 the file does not hold the fact. Settlement: CLM-4009 cover accepted, CLM-4001 no decision on cover, CLM-4010 declined (a short reply). Letter: CLM-4004 acknowledgement, CLM-4002 missing documents, CLM-4010 decline, CLM-4006 a decline that is refused (a short reply), CLM-4001 acknowledgement with no team on the record. Each case names only what the insurer's claims system holds.

cases.title: Ashgrove, struck a gate post: acknowledgement letter
cases.claim_type: Motor: damage to the insured vehicle
cases.text:
THE CLAIM
Claim: CLM-4001
Claimant: Corwin Ashgrove
Claim type: Motor: damage to the insured vehicle
Loss: 17 Nov 2026, reported 20 Nov 2026
What happened: Reversing out of the drive at home, the policyholder struck a gate post. The rear bumper and tailgate are dented and the rear windscreen is cracked. Nobody was hurt and no other vehicle or property of another person was involved.
THE REQUEST
A claims handler asks for this letter: the acknowledgement letter for claim CLM-4001
Handling team on the claim record: none is named
THE AGENT'S TASK
The agent drafts the letter from the claim file and the insurer's letter template, and checks it against what the template says the letter must include. It sends nothing. A claims handler reads and sends every letter. Everything here is as the claims system holds it. The agent reads the claim and the templates themselves from the claims system.

cases.title: Corrimond, burst pipe in the loft: settlement
cases.text:
THE CLAIM
Claim: CLM-4010
Claimant: Yvaine Corrimond
Claim type: Home: escape of water
Loss: 10 Nov 2026, reported 13 Nov 2026
Policy: POL-2010, wording TMI-HOM-02
What happened: A pipe in the loft burst while the home was empty. Water damaged two bedrooms and the stairs.
DECISION ON COVER
Declined by Fenella Arkwright, adjuster, on 20 Nov 2026 under clause 2.2
INVOICES AND ESTIMATES ON FILE
DOC-4010-3 repair estimate, Ilvane Restoration, 2 lines
THE AGENT'S TASK
The agent says which lines the wording does not cover and shows the amount payable as the claims system works it out. It pays nothing and approves nothing. The adjuster decides on cover, and the person with the authority for the amount approves a settlement. Everything here is as the claims system holds it. The agent reads the claim and the wording themselves from the claims and policy systems.
